items.title: File Widerspruch against the permit denial
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, an das Bezirksamt Musterwerder, Wasserturmweg 3, 22089 Hamburg zu richten, und zwar schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter is dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday) and no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' is stated, so the document date is the posting date. Per the letter's own clause (§41 Abs. 2 HmbVwVfG) and the verified rule, delivery is deemed on the 4th calendar day after posting: 20.11 (Fri, day1), 21.11 (Sat, day2), 22.11 (Sun, day3), 23.11 (Mon, day4) → deemed delivered Monday 23.11.2026. This is a district office (general authority, not a Finanzamt), so the deemed-delivery day is not shifted even though day4 would be a Saturday/Sunday/holiday - and here it falls on an ordinary Monday anyway. The one-month Widerspruch period (§70 VwGO) starts the day after delivery (§187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends, per §188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 23.12.2026. Checking that date: it is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Hamburg (25/26 Dec are holidays, not 23 Dec), so §193 BGB does not shift it further.
